notes.title: Save file fix.
notes.content: Fixed the issue where the game display was incorrect after resetting progress and entering the game again.

notes.title: March 22nd fixes
notes.content:
1. Added progress saving system. Now pressing ESC to exit a chapter will automatically save progress, and the next time you enter, the progress will be automatically loaded.
2. Added a reset button that allows you to reset the chapter progress and restart the game when clicked.
3. Added multiple languages for the exit prompt.
4. Added a hint button in the upper right corner of the screen. If there are items to find in the scene, the light bulb will illuminate.
5. Fixed incorrect Steam login ID.
6. Fixed the animation for flying items.
7. Items are now correctly hidden after being clicked.
